description: Takes a phase and returns up to 50 Indian IPOs in it (default allotment-this-week): upcoming, open, closed, allotted, listed, or allotment-this-week (default, allotment dates from 2 days ago to 7 days ahead). Up to 50 rows, newest first, with dates, price, lot size and the page that checks allotment. Example input: {"phase":"allotment-this-week"}

phase.description: Which IPOs to list: upcoming, open, closed, allotted, listed or allotment-this-week

name: ipo-calendar
